summary: Iter52-Google-SearchConsole verification endpoint validated end-to-end. All 8 new endpoint tests pass (correct filename→200+html+exact body; wrong filename→404; random path→404 with no catch-all; env-driven config uses os.getenv; regression on /.well-known/apple-app-site-association & assetlinks.json; regression on /api/ root; frontend public file present with correct content). Full regression suite iter47+iter50+iter51 = 66 passed / 2 skipped (both pre-existing public-URL skips unrelated). No route collision with /api/*. Ready to ship.
critical_code_review_comments: wellknown_router registers `@router.get('/{filename}')` at the app root (mounted before /api). Because FastAPI matches by segment count, `/{filename}` only matches single-segment paths, so /api/<anything> is not shadowed. Verified: GET /api/ still returns 200 with the API root payload.

Note (informational, not blocking): via public preview URL, /.well-known/apple-app-site-association and /.well-known/assetlinks.json return 404 (ingress routes non-/api paths to the frontend/Metro rather than backend). This is a pre-existing deploy-routing concern already flagged in prior iterations and is out of scope for this change. The Google verification file DOES work on the public URL because Metro static-export serves /app/frontend/public/googlea85e4f73dfe1ad08.html (belt-and-suspenders strategy confirmed effective).
Env-driven config properly uses os.getenv with sensible defaults matching the Google-provided filename/content.
